'''Remmik Kulavinar''' was the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[Shooting Star (Remmik Kulavinar's ship)|''Shooting Star'']]. In [[44 ABY]], he piloted [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Madhi Vaandt]] and her reporting crew across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] while she was doing a continuous segment for ''[[The Perre Needmo Newshour]]'' on the existing practices of [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] throughout the galaxy.
